department: Miller School of Medicine: Programs in Biomedical Sciences (PIBS)

app_fee.value: A non-refundable $85 processing fee is due at submission.
app_fee.quote: A non-refundable $85 processing fee is only due at the time of submission

fee_waiver.value: Fee waivers go only to U.S. citizens and permanent residents, and are very limited.
fee_waiver.quote: Qualified applicants who are U.S. citizens or permanent residents may request a fee waiver based on financial need

deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026; late applications may be considered if space permits.
deadline.quote: December 1st Application Deadline. Late applications may be considered if space permits

gre_general.value: The school does not require standardized tests such as the GRE or GMAT.
gre_general.quote: Standardized tests (GRE, GMAT) are not required

supervisor.value: Students choose a lab only after at least three rotations, so no supervisor is needed for admission.
supervisor.quote: Students do not commit to one of our eight biomedical science programs or laboratories until after completing a minimum of three lab rotations

funding.value: All full-time PhD students in the biomedical sciences receive full tuition support and a stipend.
funding.quote: All full-time Ph.D. students in the Biomedical Sciences receive the following: Full tuition support

also.quote: Annual stipend is $46,000 for the 2024-2025 academic year

entry_route.value: Applicants need a bachelor's degree in the biological sciences or a related field.
entry_route.quote: Applicants should have a bachelor's degree in the biological sciences or a related discipline

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: Umbrella first-year program (PIBS) that admits to eight PhD programs, including Neuroscience (listed on the Neuroscience application page). Entry is by lab rotations; the stipend figure is for 2024-2025. Other Miller PhD tracks (MSTP, Epidemiology, Biostatistics) are separate.
